run_unittests: run all discovered unit tests in the test directory using unittest.TestLoader
discover_test_files: discover all test files matching the pattern *_test.py in the test directory
shard_tests_circleci: shard a unittest.TestSuite across CircleCI parallel nodes using CIRCLE_NODE_TOTAL and CIRCLE_NODE_INDEX env vars
flatten_test_suite: flatten nested test suites into individual tests and shuffle them with a fixed random seed
run_test_suite: run a unittest.TestSuite with TextTestRunner from the command line entry point
